title: No More Arachnophobia
description: A client-side Fabric mod that replaces spiders and cave spiders with cute, non-spider creatures for players with arachnophobia.
body:
# No More Arachnophobia

No More Arachnophobia is a client-side Fabric mod that makes Minecraft spiders much less spider-like.

Instead of rendering as spiders:

- Cave spiders render as small slimes
- Regular spiders render as slightly larger slimes
- Spider sounds are replaced with vanilla Minecraft cat meows

The mod only changes visuals and sounds on your client. It does not change spider behavior, hitboxes, AI, spawning, drops, combat, or server-side gameplay.

## Client-side only

This mod only needs to be installed on the client. Servers do not need to install it.

## What it changes

- Spider renderer
- Cave spider renderer
- Spider ambient, hurt, death, and step sounds

## What it does not change

- Gameplay mechanics
- Entity behavior
- Spawn rules
- Drops
- Server logic
